title: fix(plugin-security): a delegated refusal names one reason for a target user the caller cannot read
body:
Clause-②: no — no accept set changes at the write door: every write refused before is still refused, and every write admitted is still admitted; no error code, class or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:委派管理员(业务单元范围)直接授予权限集时,只要目标用户不在其委派子树内,拒绝就只有一个答案:`403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`,同一句话、同一组 details,与目标用户是否存在、是否持有业务单元成员关系无关;授权写里点名的目标用户先按调用者自己的读权限查一次,读不到的按"不存在"处理,同样是这个答案。
- 为什么改:加固规则——委派拒绝对调用者读不到的目标用户只给一个理由;目标用户只有经由子树内的业务单元才算在子树内。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,写入口的放行与拒绝集合不变(原本被拒的仍被拒,原本放行的仍放行),不新增错误码;每次点名目标的委派授权多一次以调用者身份对 `sys_user` 的按 id 读。回滚即撤销本 PR(源码改动只在 `assertDirectGrantWrite` 及其三个小助手)。
- 先看:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `assertDirectGrantWrite`(`userBUs` 那一段与子树判断,风险 hunk),以及新增的 `callerReadsUser`、`namesTargetUser`、`referenceCheckAsksCallerAboutUser`;② `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe 与 `[#26189]` 列表里改动的一条;③ `.changeset/delegated-grant-refusal-one-reason.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`,预期 `Test Files 1 passed`、`Tests 165 passed (165)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Rule.** A target user is inside a delegated business-unit subtree only through a business unit of that subtree. A delegated administrator's direct permission-set grant whose target user is outside the subtree is refused with one answer, whether or not the user exists or holds a business-unit membership: `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`, the same sentence (`target user 'ID' is outside the delegated subtree (scope from 'SET')`, or its unnamed form) and the same details.
- **A target the caller cannot read.** A target user the grant NAMES (a new grant, or a stored grant pointed at another user) is first asked of the caller's own read door: one `sys_user` read by id, projected to `id`, under the caller's context (`callerReadsUser`). It is the question the engine's reference check asks of that user (`masterDetailHeadersCallerReads`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts:501`) and the grant-holder membership hook asks before it (`callerReadsHolder`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/grant-holder-membership-refusal.ts:350`). Neither can be called from the gate (the first is objectql's, which this package does not depend on; the second reads through a hook's `ctx.api`), so the gate asks the same read itself, and asks it only where the reference check would (`referenceCheckAsksCallerAboutUser`: `sys_user` registered and the live `user_id` a writable lookup; the grant object declares the lookup's target itself, so it is not resolved again). A user the read does not return is answered as a user that does not exist, the platform's rule for a user a non-system write names: outside the subtree, the same answer. A read the read door refuses (a declared 4xx) returns no user; a store fault propagates, as for the gate's other reads.
- **Where.** `DelegatedAdminGate.assertDirectGrantWrite` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`): one subtree test replaces two branches, and the target's memberships are read only for a target the caller may be judged on. Nothing else in the gate moves.
- **Rulings kept** (each quoted from the file and unchanged):
  - ruling on #26059, Q3 (`ScopeViolation` docblock): "A per-scope rejection reason that describes the caller's OWN delegated scope: a business unit outside the subtree, a set not in the allowlist, a target user outside the subtree … Only these answer `DelegationScopeViolationError`; a plain string reason keeps `PermissionDeniedError`." A user with no business unit in the subtree is a target user outside it, so the rule answers that class; every plain-string reason keeps `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
  - ruling of record 6649064874 (`mayName`): "Only a value the caller already has … a value it may not name is left out of the sentence and out of the details." The target is still named only when the caller wrote it or reads it.
  - ruling of record 5985885287 (`UnreadableAddressedRowRefusal`): "an id naming no row and a row the caller cannot read, refused alike." Untouched: a by-id write whose row the caller cannot read is still refused before any target user is judged.

## Tests

- New top-level describe at the foot of `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` (the gate's shared harness file), over a harness that registers `sys_user`, makes the grant's `user_id` a lookup to it and serves the caller a `sys_user` read without the users it cannot read. One target id answers a refusal identical in class, name, `code`, `status`, `statusCode`, message, details and the REST door's classification (`mapDataError`), and that answer is the scope violation (message matched whole, details matched exactly):
  - `insert` and `update` (the writes that name the target), across four states: an id naming no user, a user with no business-unit membership, a user whose business unit is outside the subtree, and a user with a business unit inside the subtree whom the caller cannot read;
  - `delete` (a stored grant of the target removed), across the first three.
  - CONTROL: the same id with a business unit inside the subtree, read by the caller, is admitted on all three shapes.
- Ablation (one-time, nothing left in the tree), each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed), then restored (blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - the caller's read of a named target removed: 2 failed of 165 (the `insert` and `update` pins), every other test green;
  - the no-membership branch put back: 3 failed of 165 (the three shape pins), every other test green;
  - restored: 165 of 165 green.
- Door reading (one-time, nothing left in the tree): the real `ObjectQL` engine over a real SQL driver with the real `SecurityPlugin` registered, postures `single`, `group` and `isolated`, two delegates (one whose set grants `sys_user` read, one whose set does not). With the rule, a new grant and a stored grant pointed at the target answer one identical envelope per delegate across the four states, the first of them an id no user carries (12 readings each; the rig's re-pointed grants each carry their own set name, the only difference in their details), and a target with a business unit inside the subtree that the caller reads is admitted on every shape.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: 249 of 249 files, 5867 passed, 45 skipped; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` (tsc, scripts tsconfig and `check:test-typecheck`) green.

## Acceptance notes

- Read in code, not measured, not filed: the write-admission preview (`canWriteObject`, `security-plugin-object-admission.ts`) returns `false` only for a `PermissionDeniedError` out of the gate; a `DelegationScopeViolationError` reaches its outer catch, which also answers `false` but logs the refusal as an admission it could not resolve. The answer is right; the log line names a failure that did not happen. Outside this PR's file surface.
- `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project) was not run locally: the diff edits none of its tests and no derived family names it; `Test Core` runs it.
